# Faik Nagiyev — Architectural, Cityscape & Fine Art Photography

> Master photographer with over 30 years of visual authority and 15+ years specializing in high-end architectural, interior, and spatial photography. Pioneer of hybrid spatial imaging: pairing medium/full-frame optical precision with AI-assisted spatial staging and surgical digital retouching.

## Quick Facts
- **Name:** Faik Nagiyev (Faiq Nağıyev)
- **Base Location:** Baku, Azerbaijan (Available Worldwide for Commissions & Remote Post-Production)
- **Specialization:** Architectural Photography, Luxury Hotel Portfolios, Commercial Real Estate, Cityscapes, Celestial Astrophotography, AI Spatial Staging, Private Client Cloud Portals
- **Experience:** 30+ years total photography practice; 15+ years in architecture & spaces
- **Key Credentials:** Finalist of the Heydar Aliyev Center Exhibition (Baku); documented 150+ luxury & boutique hotels in Azerbaijan
- **Selected Institutional Clients:** SOCAR, Heydar Aliyev Center, YARAT Contemporary Art Space, Azimport, FF Group, Shamakhy Astrophysical Observatory, Tusi-Bohm Planetarium, Ministry of Education
- **Direct Contacts:** WhatsApp: +994 50 322 21 42 | Telegram: @faiknagiyev | Email: faik [at] nagiyev.com | Website: https://photo.nagiyev.com

## Core Services
1. **Commercial Architectural & Interior Photography**
   - Perspective-corrected, optically leveled full-dynamic-range captures for hotel chains, architects, and luxury developers.
2. **Intelligent Spatial Staging & Digital Retouching (Hybrid AI Pipeline)**
   - High-fidelity post-processing: vertical keystone straightening, twilight sky replacement, digital decluttering, linen smoothening, and virtual interior staging. Available on-site or remotely worldwide for client-provided RAW files.
3. **Private Client Cloud Vault (gallery.nagiyev.com)**
   - Dedicated branded digital asset showcases with permanent 24/7 cloud availability, 4K lossless viewing, and 1-click batch ZIP downloads for investors, partners, and media.
   - Pricing: Complimentary hosting included with each shoot (1 month to 1 year depending on shoot tier); renewal at 5 AZN/month.
